sources.entry: PromptFolder - Allows users to create, save, and explore innovative prompts with features like variables, organization, and sharing. #free

summary.name: PromptFolder
summary.one_liner: PromptFolder is a web-based AI prompt manager for building, saving, organizing, and discovering reusable prompts for tools like ChatGPT and Midjourney.
use_cases: Saving and organizing reusable ChatGPT prompts
Building prompts with fill-in variables such as [subject]
Browsing trending community prompts for SEO or blog ideas
Using saved prompts directly inside ChatGPT via a Chrome extension
Creating prompts for Midjourney and other AI image tools
summary.what_it_does: PromptFolder lets users write prompts in an editor that supports variables, such as a bracketed [subject] placeholder that gets filled in before running. Prompts can be saved into folders and copied or run from the interface, with an Advanced Editor option. The page also lists a Browse Trending Prompts section with community-submitted prompts for tasks like SEO meta titles and blog post ideas. A Chrome extension is advertised for using PromptFolder inside ChatGPT. The listing describes sharing and exploring prompts as features.
notable: Chrome extension for using saved prompts directly in ChatGPT
Variable placeholders like [subject] filled in before running a prompt
Browsable library of trending community prompts
Free tools include a Midjourney Prompt Generator and ChatGPT Detector
caveats: Page does not state explicit pricing tiers; 'Sign Up Free' suggests a free entry option but paid features are not described
Chrome extension is the only platform integration named; other browsers and mobile are not mentioned
